official_sources.name: EA LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
EA LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Tiles

direct_official_checks: DTM is intended to represent terrain surface
DSM includes objects such as vehicles buildings and vegetation
surface-object removal is used to derive DTM
manual editing can be used in DTM production
DSM and DTM are not interchangeable elevation products
candidate ground elevation must use DTM not DSM
same nominal RMSE does not make DSM a valid ground substitute
surface-type provenance must be stored with each numeric sample
quality_effect: Adds a hard negative-control preventing roof/tree/vehicle elevations from entering parcel ground-height calculations.
